g.text: SCR01 — Dashboard
Kotlin Compose screen definition · FR-KT-01 / FR-KT-03 · blueprint2.0 design only
Service Running (desired running) · MCP ready · ADB offline · view ready · catalog ready · ARC disabled · 10
Phone390dp: Single-column scrolling data/detail and48dp controls; preserve explicit draft fields on rotation. Modal drawer below840dp; persistent rail
at840dp+. Back returns previous detail, with Discard/Stay for dirty drafts. Landscape: Same IDs and authorization; wide layout only when available
width>=840dp; never shrink protected actions below48dp.
SCR01.C01 · Start / Stop service
Fields: Stopped/Running desired state
Service started only after eligible foreground start and listener ready; Stop closes admission and drains verified cleanup within10s
Failure: Start eligibility or bind failure shows Error; stop timeout shows unknown cleanup and closed admission
SCR01.C02 · Open subscriptions
Fields: Subscription states, cleanup phase, route and cursor retention
Open SCR05 owner-filtered subscription list
Failure: Store unavailable shows status-only error; no register/unregister side effect
SCR01.C03 · Open navigation
Fields: SCR01..SCR08,SCR10,SCR11; protected review only via exact command
Open all local destinations through phone drawer or wide rail; Back returns previous screen
Failure: Dirty draft requires Discard/Stay; navigation never commits configuration
SCR01.C04 · Open health details
Fields: MCP, ADB, resolved view, catalog, inbound ARC, snapshot revision
Expand independent health facets and their reasons on SCR01
Failure: Missing facet is unknown, never inferred from another ready facet
SCR01.C05 · Refresh device view
Fields: Profile/target/user and current view/capability epochs
Request supported device/backend fact refresh through SCR09 then stage/activate coherent view
Failure: Denied probes retain unknown; failed refresh leaves previous view stale, no guessed availability
State definitions — exact enabled/disabled controls, effects and recovery
SCR01.S0 · Ready: service Running; facets independent
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: Listener ready; show actual ADB/view/catalog/ARC facets. Start action now means Stop.
Recovery: Stop deliberately or inspect a specific degraded facet; never infer overall readiness.
SCR01.S1 · Starting: admission closed
Disabled: SCR01.C01
Effect: Desired Running persisted; listener/device resolution not yet ready.
Recovery: Wait for bounded start or use Stop; failure transitions Error.
SCR01.S2 · Start denied: owner action required
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: No new listener/admission; reason includes precise Android eligibility or bind failure.
Recovery: Open Action required; fix prerequisite then explicitly Start again.
SCR01.S3 · Stopped: no listener and no Running badge
Disabled: SCR01.C02, SCR01.C05
Effect: Desired Stopped; no MCP/ARC socket owned by service.
Recovery: Local Start requires eligible foreground intent; boot never overrides manual Stop.
SCR01.S4 · Approval pending: open exact local challenge
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: Request retains original deadline; notification opens review, never approves.
Recovery: Open SCR09 or let deadline deny; other queued requests retain FIFO/original deadlines.
SCR01.S5 · Stopping: admission closed and cleanup bounded
Disabled: SCR01.C01, SCR01.C05
Effect: Close listeners/delivery; attempt verified cleanup before backend/store close.
Recovery: After10s report stopped with unknown obligations where necessary; never fake cleanup success.
SCR01.S6 · Runtime Error: admission closed with exact reason
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: Mandatory audit/store/backend consistency failure closes new device dispatch; listener health remains independently observed.
Recovery: Inspect SCR10 precise failure, fix the actual prerequisite, then explicit safe recovery; never replay an uncertain device effect.
SCR01.S7 · Waiting for unlock: minimal nonsecret status only
Disabled: SCR01.C01, SCR01.C02, SCR01.C05
Effect: Boot preference mirror requested startup, but credential-encrypted catalog/config/keys are unavailable. No listener/device admission.
Recovery: Unlock normally, reconcile boot preference and request eligible startup; never move secrets to device-protected storage.
